summary: Cassava was a male Nomai from Brittle Hollow who worked at the Construction Yard on Giant's Deep as part of the Ash Twin Project. Married to Daz and brother-in-law to Avens, Cassava co-built the Orbital Probe Cannon despite increasingly believing the Eye of the Universe might be impossible to find.

behavior: Cassava is increasingly pessimistic about the Nomai's chances of finding the Eye.
Cassava openly suspected the Eye might not wish to be found.
Cassava chronically interrupted Poke's forge work to ask for updates.
Cassava frequently argued with Poke and required Clary and Yarrow as mediators.
location: Cassava originally came from Brittle Hollow.
Cassava relocated to the Construction Yard on Giant's Deep to build the Orbital Probe Cannon.
Cassava's corpse can be found at the Construction Yard on Giant's Deep.
lore: Cassava grew up hearing the Nomai's story of their search for the Eye of the Universe.
Cassava was the husband of Daz.
Cassava was the brother-in-law of Avens.
Cassava built the Eye Signal Locator on the Attlerock together with Filix.
After repeated failures with the Attlerock locator, Cassava proposed a more sophisticated device.
The more sophisticated locator was built in the Southern Observatory on Brittle Hollow and also failed to detect the Eye's signal.
Cassava suggested at the next planning meeting that perhaps the Eye does not want to be found.
Cassava acknowledged Mallow's probe idea as clever but noted the chance of launching in the correct direction was virtually zero.
Conoy directed Cassava to talk to Ramie and Pye about their negative-time-interval technology.
Cassava proposed building the Orbital Probe Cannon in orbit around Giant's Deep: furthest from the sun, moonless except for Quantum Moon visits.
Cassava co-built the Orbital Probe Cannon at the Construction Yard with Avens.
Cassava initially agreed with retrieving the Vessel's old warp core as a valuable blueprint.
Cassava ultimately sided with Idaea, agreeing crafting a new Advanced Warp Core was the safest option.
Cassava's stated reasoning: if the search for the Eye is futile, choose the option with the least potential for harm.
Cassava described his arguments with Poke as 'oil and water' with Clary as their 'emulsifier.'
Cassava accused Poke of intentionally forging the Giant's Deep warp tower core last to spite him; Poke denied it.
Cassava recognized that his fear of never finding the Eye was likely the source of his arguments with Poke.
Cassava and Daz lifted Orbital Probe Cannon components into orbit using Giant's Deep cyclones.
One Orbital Probe Cannon component sank beneath the upwards current; Cassava asked Conoy for help understanding why.
Conoy and Spire explained at the Southern Observatory that a secondary type of cyclone with opposite rotation exists on Giant's Deep.
On Daz's recommendation, Cassava set Avens and Mallow's allowed maximum launch power slightly below the cannon's structural maximum.
Cassava argued with Daz and Phlox over memory statues: Cassava believed sending memories back in time is effectively the same as sending the being back in time.
Cassava and Daz remained at the Construction Yard after the Ash Twin Project was put on indefinite hold.
Cassava felt grateful and overjoyed when the Orbital Probe Cannon was finally finished, believing it would succeed.
